map.title: Support a province
map.lead: Click an il on the map, then spend credits for your tribe. Location GPS is not used.
map.hint: Select a province to spend credits.

auth.invalidPhone: Enter a valid Turkish mobile number.

merge.title: Merge accounts
merge.lead: This social account matches an existing phone account. Merging is not automatic — confirm with the code sent to your phone.

consent.title: KVKK consents
consent.lead: Before using location features you must separately accept the disclosure notice and explicit consent. This step cannot be skipped.
consent.disclosureCheck: I have read and understood the disclosure notice.
consent.locationCheck: I give my explicit consent for continuous location tracking.
consent.versionUpdated: The text was updated. Please read and accept again.
consent.saveFailed: Could not save consents. Please try again.

tribes.lead: You must join a tribe to support provinces on the map. Names are fictional; real club brands are not used.
